mission.title: Weak-coupling construction attempts
mission.statement: Construct nontrivial quantum Yang–Mills theory on R⁴ for every compact simple gauge group and prove a strictly positive mass gap.
mission.author: Deep Bhattacharjee
sources: Wilson cluster and conditional entropy constructions
gaps: Prove the same-coupling weak-coupling thermal-defect bound on the full rectangular window.
Bound the separated-seam connected response after summing spatial sites, uniformly along the tuned Wilson cutoff family.
Match the continuum construction and finite-cutoff transfer estimates on one family.
Control neutral states and all required gauge groups.

examples: An exact ring replay isolates one winding activity. On the doubled Wilson graph, Möbius activities that depend on only one seam cancel from the mixed difference.
The exact transfer trace equals one plus the two-layer chi-square divergence. A conditional chain with tilted block histories replays that trace.
An exact finite transfer calculation checks two equal and two opposite permutation endpoints. The Wilson identity reduces the defect to the integrated connected response across two separated seams.
Rechecked sharp same-box defect contraction a(2T) <= a(T)^2/(2-a(T)^2). A uniform defect seed V/(13510000 T^3) implies the conditional pressure seed V/(26880000 T^3).
An even-parity massless oscillator at spatial side 2T has a thermal defect above 2/2187, whereas the required seed is 1/1688750.
Bound the separated-seam connected response after summing spatial sites, uniformly along the tuned Wilson cutoff family.
Control neutral states and all required gauge groups.
